author: Artem
text: I went to the regatta in Marmaris with the guys and loved everything! Great company, a cool atmosphere and good organisation. Igor and Sofa are true professionals at what they do. The guys organised everything at the highest level. With them it felt comfortable and calm both during training and during the regatta itself. We had a great time, got loads of positive emotions and new experience. Thanks to the guys for a great trip!
